factories.name: newListStoryIDsStep
factories.description: List current Hacker News story IDs in feed order. Choose feed top, best, new, ask (Ask HN), or show (Show HN), and limit from 1 to 500. Read each returned ID as a Hacker News item for its title and links.

inputSchema.description: ListStoryIDsInput selects one feed snapshot. It does not select a historical time window.

feed.description: Feed is top, best, new, ask, or show. Empty selects top.

limit.description: Limit bounds returned IDs from 1 through 500. Zero selects 50.

factories.name: newGetItemStep
factories.description: Read one public Hacker News story, comment, job, or poll by its positive item ID. Returns title, author, score, source URL, discussion URL, text as untrusted HTML, and child comment IDs to read next.

inputSchema.description: GetItemInput identifies one story, comment, job, poll, or poll option.

id.description: ID is a positive Hacker News item ID.

factories.name: newSearchStoriesStep
factories.description: Search Hacker News stories, including Ask HN and Show HN posts, by keyword. Give query words; optionally sortBy date for newest first, tags show_hn, ask_hn, or front_page, createdAfter and createdBefore as RFC 3339 times, minPoints, and a zero-based page with hitsPerPage from 1 to 100. Returns story IDs, titles, source and discussion URLs, authors, points, comment counts, creation times, plain story text, and the next page number, which is zero after the last page.

inputSchema.description: SearchStoriesInput selects one page of a keyword story search. Every field is optional.

createdAfter.description: CreatedAfter keeps stories submitted strictly after this time. Zero sets no lower bound.

createdBefore.description: CreatedBefore keeps stories submitted strictly before this time. Zero sets no upper bound. When both bounds are set, CreatedBefore must be later than CreatedAfter.

hitsPerPage.description: HitsPerPage is the page size from 1 through 100. Zero selects 20.

minPoints.description: MinPoints keeps stories with at least this many points. Zero sets no minimum; negative is invalid.

page.description: Page is the zero-based result page. Zero selects the first page. Page times HitsPerPage must stay below 1000, because the Search API serves only the first 1000 hits of a query.

query.description: Query is the full-text keyword query, at most 512 bytes, matched against story titles, URLs, authors, and submitted text. Quoted phrases and -excluded words follow the Search API syntax. Empty matches every story that the other filters allow.

sortBy.description: SortBy is relevance or date. Empty selects relevance; date returns the newest stories first.

tags.description: Tags lists story, show_hn, ask_hn, or front_page. A story must carry every listed tag. The story tag is always applied, so empty searches all stories, including Ask HN and Show HN posts.
